actions.description: Read .audit-tools/zizmor-1.25.2.dist-info/INSTALLER — contents: 'pip'. This confirms zizmor 1.25.2 was installed via pip into .audit-tools/. The scope includes two security audit binaries: actionlint (GitHub Actions workflow linter, ELF x86-64) in .audit-bin/ and zizmor 1.25.2 (GitHub Actions security scanner) in both .audit-bin/ and .audit-tools/bin/. These appear to be vendor-committed audit tool binaries added to the repository for use in CI security scanning workflows.
